questions.question: I had a hard time (a)/ paying the driver (b)/ as I had (c)/ only hundreds rupee note.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'only hundreds rupee note' ki jagah inme se koi ek use karenge:
- only one hundred rupee note (Sirf ek 100 rupees ka note)
- only one hundred rupees (Sirf 100 rupees)
- only hundred rupee notes (Sirf 100-100 rupees wale note)

questions.question: When I was walking (a)/ along the bank of the river, (b)/ I saw an asleep man (c)/ in rags and tatters.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'I saw a man who was asleep' in place of 'I saw an asleep man'.
Explanation:- kyunki 'asleep' ek aisa adjective hai jo ki noun se pehle nahi lagaya jaata balki iska use predicatively yaani linking verb ke baad likh kar kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Don't worry, (a)/ there is less time (b)/ for the train to arrive.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) replace 'less' with 'some/enough/a little'
Explanation:- yahan koi comparison nahi ho raha isliye 'less' ka use nahi hoga. Sahi meaning ke liye 'some time', 'enough time', ya 'a little time' laga sakte hain.

questions.question: The food tasted deliciously (a)/ and all present in the party (b)/ enjoyed it to their full. (c)/ no error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) Use 'delicious' in place of 'deliciously'
Explanation:- kyunki 'taste' ek linking verb ki tarah se kaam kar rahi hai isliye uske baad koi adverb nahi balki adjective ('delicious') ka use kiya jayega.

questions.question: He lost (a)/ all his (b)/ hardly earned money. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'hard' instead of 'hardly'
Explanation:- 'Hardly' (naa ke barabar) aur 'Hard' (mehenat se/zor se), toh sahi meaning ke liye 'hard earned money' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everything will be done (a)/ to bring (b)/ the responsible people to justice. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Use 'people responsible' in place of 'responsible people'.
Explanation:- 'responsible people' ka matlab jimmedar log aur 'people responsible' ka matlab 'log jo kisi cheez (crime/fault) ke liye jimmedar hain'. Isliye 'people responsible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She ran so fastly (a)/ that I could (b)/ not overtake her.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a) use 'fast' instead of 'fastly'
Explanation:- kyunki 'fastly' koi word nahi hota, correct word 'fast' hota hai chahe adjective banana ho yaa adverb.

questions.question: Even today (a)/ it is incredulous to think (b)/ that men have walked on the moon.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) Use 'incredible' in place of 'incredulous'.
Explanation:- 'incredible' = impossible or very difficult to believe; 'incredulous' = not willing or not able to believe something. Sentence ke meaning ke according 'incredible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Platinum is (a)/ costlier than (b)/ any metal (c)/ found on earth.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Replace 'any metal' with 'any other metal'
Explanation:- kyunki jab ek noun ka comparison ek aise group se karna hota hai jiska wo khud ek part hota hai toh usse 'other' lagakar exclude karna padta hai.

questions.question: A skilful advertiser may be able to create (a)/ practically a monopoly for himself (b)/ not because his product is superior to (c)/ but because he has succeeded in inducing people to believe that it is.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) Remove 'to' after 'superior'.
Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'to' preposition ke baad koi noun hi available nahi hai isliye yahan 'superior' ke baad 'to' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Deepak said he would pack (a)/ few things he had (b)/ and vacate the hostel room (c)/ the next day.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'the few' instead of 'few'
Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh hai ki wo apni thodi jitni cheezen hain wo pack karega. Whole quantity ke liye 'the few' ka use karte hain.

questions.question: Although the toys (a)/ are altogether (b)/ in the cupboard (c)/ they are not properly arranged.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b) use 'all together' instead of 'altogether'
Explanation:- 'Altogether' ka matlab 'in total/completely', 'All together' ka matlab 'with each other' (ek sath), toh meaning ke according 'all together' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Scientists have found (a)/ that life was creeping and crawling about the Earth (b)/ 1.5 billion years early than (c)/ previously thought.(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) use 'earlier' instead of 'early'
Explanation:- kyunki 'early' positive degree hoti hai aur yahan 'than' se pata chal raha ki comparison karna hai, isliye comparative degree 'earlier' ka use hoga.

questions.question: You should know (a)/ that the blind (b)/ leads a very difficult life. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'leads' with 'lead'.
Explanation:- 'the blind' ka matlab hai saare blind people, 'the + adjective' common plural noun banata hai isliye inke sath plural verb ('lead') ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I will give you (a)/my notes if you promise (b)/to return the same by Sunday. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'the same' with 'them'
Explanation:- 'the same' ka use adjective ke roop mein kiya jaata hai par hume yahan pronoun ('them') ki zarurat hai jo 'notes' noun ko refer karega.

questions.question: The photograph which (a)/ was taken by Rahul is (b)/ comparatively better than this one.(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c) replace 'better' with 'good' (or remove 'comparatively')
Explanation:- 'comparatively' ke sath adjective ki positive degree aati hai ya 'better than' ke sath 'comparatively' hata diya jata hai.

questions.question: The stranger stood quietly for few moments.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'few' ka matlab (na ke barabar), 'the few' ka matlab (specific/particular) and 'a few' ka matlab (kuch). Yahan meaning ke according 'for a few moments' best option hai.

questions.question: We live in a populated country of 120 million people.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- 'Populous' (Adjective): wo area jahan bahut sare log rahte hai. Yahan country noun ke liye adjective 'populous' aayega.

questions.question: This package is ideal for infant teenager who are just getting started with babysitting.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Infant teenager jaisa koi term possible hi nhi hai. Sentence mein teenagers ka kisi aur se comparison nahi hai isliye 'young teenagers' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Between Raima and Saima, the former is intelligent, while the latter is beautiful.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- latter = 2 cheezo mein se baad wala, later = fir kabhi/baad mein (time). Yahan meaning ke according 'latter is' sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: With tear eyes, she said goodbye to her dear friend.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- yahan eyes ke liye adjective chahiye. 'teary' adjective hota hai jiska matlab (filled with tears), toh sahi option 'teary eyes' hoga.

questions.question: The apple tree was loaded of fruit.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Trees pe lage fruits ke liye and person pe emotion burden yaa responsibilities etc ke liye loaded nahi 'laden with' ka use hota hai.

questions.question:
Select the correct superlative degree of adjective for the given sentence.
The money arrived when I (little) expected it.
options: (a) The money arrived when I expected it.
(b) The money arrived when I least expected it.
(c) The money arrived when I less expected it.
(d) The money arrived when I little expected it
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan little ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'least' hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question:
Select the correct superlative degree of comparison for the given sentence.
This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
options: (a) This is one of the most beautiful places in the area.
(b) This is one of the more beautiful places in the area.
(c) This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
(d) This is a beautiful place in the area.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'beautiful' ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'most beautiful' hoti hai. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question:
Select the correct degree of comparison for the given sentence.
David looks (old) than he really is.
options: (a) David looks old than he really is.
(b) David looks older than he really is.
(c) David looks elder than he really is.
(d) David looks elder from he really is.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan 'old' ki comparative degree likhni hai jo ki 'older' hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Gel ingredients work well on waved, curled, relax and texture hair in the long run.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'hair' noun ke liye adjective ka use karna hai. Parallelism and meaning ke according saare past participle form mein use hue hai, isliye 'relaxed and textured' option A sahi hai.

questions.question: It has been my great misfortune to follow a speech more notable for its volume than for any sense.
options: (c) to follow a speech much notable
(d) to have being following a speech more notable
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan speech ki length and sense ka comparison hai isliye yahan comparative degree sahi lagi hai. Isliye option B 'No improvement required' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This is on far a best ice cream I have ever had.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Superlative degree ki intensity badhane ke liye 'by far' ka use hota hai. Isliye 'by far the best' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: Robin has less marbles than George.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'less' uncountable ke liye aata hai but marbles countable hai isliye 'fewer marbles' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: One must care as for family members as possible.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Simile ('as much ... as') mein positive degree ka hi use hota hai isliye 'as much for family members' sahi hai.

questions.question: This TV channel has a larger viewership from another channel.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Comparative degree 'larger' ke baad 'than' ka use hoga aur channel ko group se exclude karne ke liye 'any other' ka use hoga. Isliye 'than any other channel' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This mango tree yields lot of mangoes every year.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Yahan 'mangoes' ke liye quantitative adjective chahiye, isliye 'a lot of' ka use hoga.

questions.question: You must start your work without some farther delay.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning dena hai 'bina koi bhi aur delay ke' isliye 'any further delay' ka use hoga.

questions.question: There is no need to make changes in many part of this sentence as it is grammatically correct.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Sahi meaning yeh hoga ki 'kisi bhi part mein changes karne ki jarurat nahi hai', isliye 'in any part of' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Priya had strong enough to fight all odds and succeed in meeting her goals in life.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Kisi person ki koi quality bataane ke liye generally 'Subject + linking verb + Adjective' structure ka use hota hai. Isliye 'was strong' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Children need much of guidance in how to use the internet wisely and efficiently.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yahan positive mein baat karni hai aur 'of' preposition bhi ek hint hai ki 'a lot of' ka use hoga. Isliye 'a lot' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can find several kind of birds in the Mysore Zoo, Pelicans, Flamingos, Hornbills and Egrets.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'several' ke baad noun plural aata hai. Isliye 'several kinds of birds' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: "Can you give me so many examples of subordinate clauses?", the teacher asked the class.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- Sentence ke meaning ke according teacher yahan students ko aur examples ke liye puch raha hai, isliye 'some more examples of' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Lenovo has launched ThinkPad XI Fold, the world's first foldable laptop which is claimed to be so durable as its other devices.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Simile mein positive degree adjective ka use hota hai aur 'so...as' ka use sirf negative meaning ke liye hota hai. Isliye 'to be as durable as' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Rahul thinks that this is quite the cheap restaurant.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Structure: quite + a/an + adjective + noun. Sentence mein emphasise karna hai isliye 'quite a cheap' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He spends good deal of money on clothing.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- 'a lot of' ki tarah 'a good deal of' phrase bhi quantity dikhaane ke liye use kiya jata hai. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The author is not well known. Little bit people have heard of him.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'people' countable noun hai aur 'Author well known nahi hai' matlab 'naa ke barabar' log jaante honge, isliye 'Few people' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: My mother looked at Sana and me with her mouth slight openly.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- Yahan 'mouth' noun ko qualify karna hai isliye 'open' adjective ka use hoga aur 'open' adjective ke liye 'slightly' adverb ka. Isliye 'slightly open' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Water and minerals presented to the soil are absorbed by the roots.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (c)
Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'water and minerals jo soil mein present hote hain', isliye adjective 'present in the soil' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with as much interest as I was.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Interest' uncountable noun hai isliye 'as much interest as' sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: It is much more difficult to judge oneself than to judge others.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'Much more difficult' sahi use hua hai. Isme 'difficult' adjective ke liye 'more' comparative degree bana rahi hai aur 'much' adverb 'more' ki intensity badhane ke liye aaya hai.

questions.question: There will be little more pupils in the class next year, but we have enough space.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'Pupils' countable noun hai aur 'kuch aur students honge next year' positive meaning ke liye 'a few more' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: India have a many all-rounders to match the talent and dedication of Kapil Dev.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (d)
Explanation:- 'India' singular hai aur 'all-rounders' countable plural noun hai, isliye grammar aur meaning ke according 'has few' option D hi sahi hai.

questions.question: Prithvi likes baseball as long as she likes cricket.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (b)
Explanation:- 'likes' verb ke comparison ke liye simile mein adverb 'much' ka use hoga isliye 'as much as' sahi hai.

questions.question: When it started raining, I ran to the nearer house for shelter.
questions.solutionHinglish:
Ans (a)
Explanation:- Meaning and grammar ke according 'the nearest house' option A hi sahi hai.
